verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a card-issuing API platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents per-item operations: creating a single paymentInstrument, updating one card via /paymentInstruments/{id}, and activating, suspending or closing individual cards. Transaction rules and pooled funds are adjacent automation features, not bulk actions across many items, so no evidence shows batch or bulk endpoints or UI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
